extensions.northStar: Incumbent Baseline — One Studio, Many Motions

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Default card rest, primary button, inputs (--shadow-soft).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Incumbent primary CTA — amber fill, soft shadow, md radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:2.75rem; padding:0 1.25rem; border-radius:0.5rem; background:oklch(46% 0.13 48); color:oklch(99% 0.005 82); font-weight:500; box-shadow:0 1px 0 oklch(22% 0.016 55 / 0.04), 0 12px 32px oklch(22% 0.016 55 / 0.06); border:0; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:oklch(40% 0.12 48); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Raised bordered card; interactive variant adds lift shadow + slight translate.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius:0.875rem; border:1px solid oklch(88% 0.012 82); background:oklch(99.4% 0.004 82); padding:1.25rem; box-shadow:0 1px 0 oklch(22% 0.016 55 / 0.04), 0 12px 32px oklch(22% 0.016 55 / 0.06); color:oklch(22% 0.016 55); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Raised bordered field with soft shadow; invalid uses strength accent border.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:2.75rem; border-radius:0.5rem; border:1px solid oklch(88% 0.012 82); background:oklch(99.4% 0.004 82); padding:0.5rem 0.75rem; color:oklch(22% 0.016 55); box-shadow:0 1px 0 oklch(22% 0.016 55 / 0.04), 0 12px 32px oklch(22% 0.016 55 / 0.06); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(46% 0.13 48); outline-offset:2px; }
